name: Shepherd's Pie
desc: Ground beef and mixed vegetables in a ketchup-brightened gravy under a garlicky sour cream and cheddar mash.

source.title: Chef John's Shepherd's Pie
source.evidence: All eleven ingredients and amounts match this page (1 1/4 lb Yukon Golds boiled with 3 garlic cloves, 1 lb lean beef, 3 tbsp ketchup, 4 cups frozen mixed vegetables, 3/4 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup cheddar divided) and the same 375°F bake; the page specifies light sour cream.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
4 cups frozen mixed vegetables (no need to thaw)

steps: Put the potatoes and garlic in a large pot with enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 20 min.
Meanwhile, brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking it up, until no pink remains, 6-8 min. Stir the flour into the beef and its drippings.
Add the broth, ketchup, frozen vegetables, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook until thickened, about 5 min.
Spread the beef mixture in a 2-quart (8x8 in) ovenproof baking dish.
Drain the potatoes and garlic, crush them a little, then add 1/4 cup of the cheddar and the sour cream and mash until smooth.
Spoon the mash onto the center of the filling and spread it to the edges with a fork. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup cheddar.
Bake until the cheese is melted and golden and the filling bubbles at the edges, 20-25 min. Let cool 15 min before serving.
